purpose: Evaluate in-game Sims 4 likes/dislikes offers caused by skill and aspiration events; never conflate with occult/life-state or skill reward-trait dialogs.
constraints: No live action unless an exact, freshly observed game prompt and selected Sim match
No automatic input for unknown preference, unfamiliar packs, ambiguous button, life-state or trait reward dialogs
Positive skill likes and negative skill dislikes are advisory, not universal personality truths
Explicit agent-session opt-in and independent screen, save, scene, PID and player ownership gates remain mandatory
YES and OK are separate steps and OK requires distinct new observation and verified prior YES receipt
A user override outranks any heuristic; do not infer permission from catalog, P95 design, UI coordinates, or a model
Preference recommendations may run while other application owns the desktop; only the input lease requires desktop control
Video Gaming offers require current native recipient state and a shared continuation comparison. Other catalog policies retain their existing rules.
Offer recipient SimData.sim_id is independent from currently selected Sim and is carried in each staged Video Gaming response receipt.
Do not obtain current needs from unauthorized or stale save slots; persisted fields only establish schema, not running-game state.
Both branches use one common continuation action chain, with only independently sourced preference effect estimates varying; divergent paths or tied scores HOLD.
Native preference response and activity resumption are not certified by offline scoring or by a SimTravel event.

comparison.rule: YES and NO are compared for the offer recipient's canonical SimData.sim_id against the same continuation_steps; only provenance-bearing predicted preference effects differ.
comparison.recipient_id: Canonical exact uint64 decimal text; never selected-Sim portrait ID or lossy float coercion.
comparison.source_truth: EA generated.zip persistence schemas show field locations, not live values. Disk saves are not live source and require separate authorized slot. Never synthesize values, native hooks or EA field numbers.
comparison.catalog_role: The Video Gaming catalog entry classifies the topic. Its recommendation requires live recipient evidence. Other catalog topics continue to use their existing policies.
comparison.effect_admission: NO_GAME_EFFECT_IN_SOURCE_POLICY; native offer event/recipient tracker required; input lease and confirmed OK/No+activity reobservation remain separate.
